reason: The asserted output 10 depends on named workers in void-returning functions executing concurrently and on function/worker completion timing: the immediate worker sets i to 10 while a delayed worker later invokes another worker-bearing function that sets i to 5. Named worker declarations and their lifecycle behavior are not covered by the supported feature lists. runtime:sleep itself is explicitly supported.
